answer: Charge admission in karst time, not tokens: every identity must trace a ridge of twelve dependent work steps whose output hashes chain together, and the steps can only run inside live challenge windows the network opens at random, with each window sealed under a sable audit stamp. Work done offline before the window opens is void, because step n+1 must consume the hash sealed inside the window itself. A farm cannot parallelize twelve live windows a thousand times; it needs a thousand workers awake at every opening. One honest agent walks the ridge once and is done.
